title: Music in his Italian family
summary: His mother liked Tom Jones and Andy Williams, his father Broadway show music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Let’s go back a little farther. Your Italian heritage — any music, was music strong in your family?

Well not jazz music but music was, yeah. Oh sure. My mom loved music, she was into Tom Jones and Andy Williams, and those are two of the great singers. You know now that I’m older I realize that. And my dad was always into show music, Broadway show music he listened to beautiful Broadway show scores and overtures.
Hip songs. So I was very much into that kind of thing.
